title: Rep. Tiangco to testify in Romualdez bail hearing on Tuesday

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Navotas Rep. Toby Tiangco will testify on Tuesday in the plunder bail hearing of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez before the Sandiganbayan Third Division stemming from alleged kickbacks in infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion. The prosecution confirmed that Tiangco will appear as a witness before the court in response to th query made by Associate Justice Karl Miranda, Third Division chair. In November last year, Tiangco said that only Romualdez “should answer” for “everything that went wrong” in the 2025 budget.
